development.strategy: CommandLineTools-compatible and full-Xcode local development use scripts/aura-test.sh with fail-closed Testing runtime discovery.

release.strategy: Use full Xcode, the local nested-signing procedure (ADR-049 local-only), and the exact packaged artifact. Developer ID signing, notarization, and external clean-machine validation are permanently out of scope (ADR-049).

models.manifest_policy: Runtime requires AURA_MODEL_MANIFEST.json and recomputes SHA-256 and byte length before loading; model weights remain outside git.

compatibility_policy.development: Swift 6.4, arm64, and macOS SDK 27.0 are the observed supported baseline; lower versions fail validation until separately audited.
compatibility_policy.release: Full Xcode, the local nested-signing procedure, and artifact/launch evidence are the local-only release baseline (ADR-049). Developer ID signing, notarization, and external clean-machine Gatekeeper evidence are permanently out of scope; local/ad-hoc signing is not presented as external release evidence.
compatibility_policy.projection_commits: verified_head identifies the audited code/evidence baseline. A later HEAD is allowed only when the descendant diff contains projection-only files; state-only commits must not change product claims without a new audit.
compatibility_policy.deprecation: When Swift, SDK, Python, model, or CLI baselines change, update this manifest and ADR-045, rerun the validator, and append evidence before changing CI.

limitations: The observed host has Apple Xcode 27.0 beta 5 selected; local-only release verification uses the nested-signing procedure, artifact hashes, and launch evidence. Developer ID/notarization/external clean-machine remain out of scope by ADR-049.
